name: ukpc-remote-control
description: Remote Control fleet backend — rc-api, rc-relay, rc-ingest, rc-web

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rc/shared && npm run build -w @rc/api && npm run build -w @rc/relay && npm run build -w @rc/ingest && npm run build -w @rc/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rc/shared && npm run test -w @rc/fake-agent
scripts.test:int: RC_TEST_RESTART=1 AGENT_JWT_EXPIRES_SEC=2 node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/ingest.test.js tests/session.test.js tests/security.test.js
